infinity.command: AGENTS=10000 TURNS=20 WAVE=500 cargo run --release -p infinity-agent-core --example agent_scale
infinity.honesty: Their agent_scale: scripted model, in-memory stores, RSS after agents idle. Reproduced on this host at pinned commit — not Pi hardware.

clawql.honesty: Parked fair agents via ParkedBagApi (JSON bags). Process keeps agent ids only after park; residentKiBPerAgent = total process VmRSS / N (same board definition as fair-v2). diskBytesPerAgent = sum(bag file sizes) / N. History lives on disk, not in RSS.
